changes.title: Repair untargetable Wraiths without changing combat balance
changes.text: If a live Wraith or Tormented Spirit remains visible in the current floor but its actor registration was lost, reattach that same monster to the combat actor registry. Melee, projectiles, bombs, fire and Examine then address the real character; never respawn or adjust its HP/evasion.

changes.title: Blacksmith quest exits return to the main dungeon
changes.text: The quest branch navigation now shows Return to Main Dungeon instead of a nonfunctional Descend option; safe existing stair travel and the ordinary main-floor Up/Down controls are preserved.

changes.title: Extend offline UIMSD terminology safely
changes.text: UIMSD search, topic exploration and exact question matching share one immutable extensible schema-term registry. Ambiguous wording and hidden columns fail closed. No AI service or row-value indexing.

changes.title: Validate exact Wraith/Blacksmith behavior and retain existing source investigations
changes.text: Six new Wraith orphan-repair tests and six already-green branch return regressions, plus twenty unrelated Mimic/electricity exact source tests and UIMSD terminology coverage. Full core and native Android verifications required. No fictitious original-player reproduction claim.

changes.title: Retain TEST303 source history and two-APK delivery requirements
changes.text: Permanent Wraith and Blacksmith source checkpoint plus earlier Mimic and UIMSD reports, exact previous produced APK history, signing, 18 rules and original saves. Build both separately named owner-private variants with no publication.
